package.name: bluerov_control_bt_nodes
package.description: BlueROV-specific Behavior Tree leaf nodes for reuse with Kyubic's bt_executor (behavior_tree package). CheckBuoyDetected/CheckBuoyInFrame/CheckBuoyPosition (detection), CheckPingerPitch (condition), WriteHydrophoneWaypointCSV/ WriteAxisOverrideWaypointCSV/WriteVisionWaypointCSV (odom-relative single-checkpoint CSV writers, for handing movement off to path_planner's WaypointAction/PDLA). Used by behavior_tree's bt_xml/iwakuni2026.xml, the current BlueROV mission control tree.
